demand.thread_name: Hope知识库-图谱线程-【PWA21场景编导耦合与黄金样本补齐】
demand.goal: 为 Hope PWA 21 个真实场景补齐写作组、导演组、场景画像、Image2故事板导出和防同质化候选知识。
demand.problem_statement: 切换场景类型后，旧正文、镜头和故事板提示词容易复用暴雨、旧巷、追兵、证物、躲避、压迫模板。

demand.golden_sample_goal: 补齐场景类型 × 写作组 × 导演组 × 黄金样本质量锚点 × Image2故事板导出的耦合知识。

recommendations.chinese_title: PWA 21场景三层路由
recommendations.candidate_summary: Create a scene-type route that separately drives body rewrite, storyboard shot planning and Image2 sheet focus for all 21 PWA scenes. Scene type is a structural input, not a style adjective.
pwa_behavior_repair: when current_scene_type differs from scene_type_at_body_generation, mark body_stale_after_scene_change true
rewrite_mode must rebuild location, conflict, rhythm, prop and action density from source facts
old alley pursuit evidence cannot survive unless the new scene profile explicitly permits pursuit or alley pressure
futureqa: Runtime trace wiring remains FutureQA until user opens implementation gate.
blocked_runtime_payloads: real director or studio style switch

recommendations.chinese_title: 写作组场景化正文重构画像
recommendations.candidate_summary: Writing group rules convert stable material facts into new narrative objective, conflict type, beat order, emotion curve, dialogue/action ratio and stale-body decision per scene.
pwa_behavior_repair: body must be regenerated when scene type changes structural goal
character names and confirmed relationships can persist
location, prop, conflict, rhythm and action density should be rebuilt unless source facts hard-lock them
futureqa: Needs implementation-time stale-body trace tests.

recommendations.chinese_title: 导演组场景化镜头画像
recommendations.candidate_summary: Director group rules translate the rewritten body into scene-specific shot rhythm, shot-size progression, camera tendency, blocking, continuity and readability requirements.
pwa_behavior_repair: fight scenes require readable action causality
dialogue scenes require gaze, pause and silence rather than chase coverage
SLG scenes require map/interface state instead of person-scale camera grammar
futureqa: Needs scene matrix spot checks after KB apply.

recommendations.chinese_title: 场景切换事实保留边界
recommendations.candidate_summary: Defines which facts survive scene switching and which facts must be rewritten. Names, confirmed relationships and core objective can persist; location, conflict device, pacing, props and action density usually change by scene profile.
pwa_behavior_repair: old body should be stale if its scene_type_id differs and its setting/conflict/props do not match the new scene profile
preserve names, relationship roles, confirmed object identity and target duration only if still semantically compatible
rewrite scene action, space, conflict mechanic, dialogue/action balance and Image2 visual focus
futureqa: Needs exact stale-state UI behavior in implementation gate.
blocked_runtime_payloads: old body reuse as hidden strong anchor

recommendations.chinese_title: 场景类型剧情节拍差异矩阵
recommendations.candidate_summary: A 21-scene beat matrix prevents all scenes from using the same pursuit-evidence-pressure chain by requiring distinct objective, obstacle, turn, reveal and closure logic.
pwa_behavior_repair: each scene must choose a beat family before writing body text
scene switch cannot keep the old beat chain unless the new profile matches it
SLG scenes should use state-change and outcome beats rather than character chase beats
futureqa: Need future golden samples per scene family.

recommendations.chinese_title: 场景类型对白动作比例矩阵
recommendations.candidate_summary: Defines scene-specific dialogue/action balance: combat, chase, siege and march are action-dominant; dialogue, council and healing are silence/subtext/dialogue-dominant; spectacle and SLG are visual-state dominant.
pwa_behavior_repair: emotional_dialogue cannot become chase or fight coverage
hot_blood_battle cannot become pure monologue
battle_report should summarize outcome and data state instead of spoken drama
futureqa: Needs validation thresholds after runtime gate.
blocked_runtime_payloads: dialogue inserted into data-only SLG report

recommendations.chinese_title: 场景类型地点道具差异保护
recommendations.candidate_summary: Prevents old alley, rain, pursuer and evidence props from leaking into scenes where the profile requires domestic room, court hall, wall siege, map table, ink space, city street anomaly, weapon detail, camp route or UI report.
pwa_behavior_repair: location and prop classes must be selected from current scene profile
old pursuit objects must be blocked for healing, council, SLG report and city growth scenes

futureqa: Needs object-continuity regression after apply gate.
blocked_runtime_payloads: map scenes rewritten as small alley
